problem_type: Standalone ESM runtime bindings and serialized browser scopes are incompletely connected
symptom: CI first failed on missing expect (fixed in 6492); the authorized follow-up source audit finds eleven unresolved uses across screenshotDir, screenshotSettled and electronProcess that could fail later screenshot/close branches.
direct_cause: A copied screenshot directory name never binds to the actual created evidenceDir; screenshotSettled lacks its canonical import; the close-timeout fallback refers to a child-process handle never obtained from the launched app. The first missing expect masked these later branches.
class_root: Every standalone runtime symbol must bind to its real module/resource owner, and Node versus serialized renderer scopes must be checked independently rather than supplied ambient runner/browser globals.
affected_population: Other standalone journeys that use the same canonical expect
Success screenshot stages and the five-second shutdown failure fallback
Node standalone scope and serialized renderer callback scopes
entry_points: CI test:e2e -> node tests/ux/smoke.e2e.mjs -> existing expect calls
core-smoke-spend-confirm.walk.mjs as a second actual standalone ownership control
internal_only_reason: Local module/resource ownership is established by actual ESM imports, the existing created evidence directory, launch return shape and screenshot helper source. ESLint supplies semantic scope analysis; no external App/runtime or media behavior is assumed.
invariants: Explicitly import expect from ./_assert.mjs in smoke, without changing any assertion or pass count
Do not declare a global expect, change ESLint globals or bypass the collecting owner with direct runner imports
New structural tests read source only; do not import or execute Electron standalone modules
Removing the actual canonical import must be rejected for both real standalone scripts
Preserve all three active smoke expect calls and reject vacuous/no-assertion inputs
All screenshots retain the three existing filenames under the real evidenceDir created by mkdirSync; no dummy directory or placeholder global
screenshotSettled comes from ./_assert.mjs and electronProcess from the returned app.process(); preserve existing close race and kill behavior
No-config ESLint Linter checks the complete module with globals.node and isolated serialized renderer callbacks with globals.browser

Do not suppress unresolved identifiers with inline global/disable directives; retain all prior canonical-owner negative controls

door_reduction.why_not: Original assertions, screenshot captures and process cleanup remain distinct legitimate consumers. The obsolete unbound screenshotDir reference is removed, while all captures reuse the already-existing evidenceDir owner. Before/after maps are generated by the unchanged mapDoors API over the same two real standalone files.

generality_proof: Preserve both real standalone expect ownership controls and all wrong-owner/global/comment/alias negatives. New no-config ESLint no-undef checks cover the full real smoke and a second real standalone, including success/catch/finally branches and serialized browser callbacks. Virtual deletion of each real expect/screenshotSettled/evidenceDir/electronProcess binding must produce an unresolved identifier. Runtime-separation canaries reject browser globals outside callbacks, Node/captured globals inside callbacks, and inline bypass comments. AST ownership tests require the real created evidence directory, canonical screenshot import, all three original filenames, and app.process(). No standalone, App, screenshot or browser is executed.

prevention.invariant: Every standalone lifecycle symbol is connected to its real owner and all ordinary/renderer lexical uses resolve in the proper runtime.
prevention.failure_mode: Canonical owner and no-undef regressions reject missing imports, missing resource/process bindings and incorrect cross-runtime captures before an App is started.
prevention.strategy: Keep the prior expect repair, bind canonical screenshot helper and returned process, and replace the obsolete directory name with the existing created owner. Use existing ESLint semantic scope analysis rather than a handwritten identifier resolver.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove undeclared ambient expect dependence (prior batch) and obsolete screenshotDir/missing screenshot/process bindings without dropping any capture, assertion, close timeout or forced-termination step.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Reuse the existing assertion wrapper and existing TypeScript/Vitest structural-test pattern; no new dependency or API replacement.

migration: No user-data migration. The existing outputs/canvas-smoke directory remains the artifact owner, now also used by its three success captures; the actual launched app supplies the existing termination fallback.
residual_risks: No App, browser, screenshot, Provider, full suite or large typecheck run; actual e2e smoke success remains coordination acceptance
The structural scope is the actual smoke plus a second real standalone control, not a claim that every unrelated journey was audited

The real-diff contract check retains one structural-prevention advisory because its path classifier treats executable tests/ux/smoke.e2e.mjs as test-only. The actual ESM import fixes runtime binding; no fake src artifact, scope change, checker exemption or one_off downgrade is added.
No actual screenshot write, directory permission check, app shutdown or forced-kill branch is executed in this Node-only task; the coordinator must run the real smoke

Renderer scope detection is bounded to inline evaluate/evaluateAll/waitForFunction callbacks used by the two checked entries; Electron app.evaluate remains Node. This is not a whole-repository audit of arbitrary serialization helpers.
